nodes.title: H3 条件构建 · 文生 / 首尾帧

widgets_values:
Ultra-realistic cinematic wuxia duel in a snow-covered temple courtyard at blue twilight.

A female swordswoman faces a tall white-robed assassin in a quiet snowy temple courtyard beneath bare trees. Cold breath is visible in the air, snow falls lightly, and robes move in the winter wind.

0–3s: tense silent standoff. Medium-wide cinematic shot, subtle sideways camera movement, strong atmosphere, both characters motionless and focused.

3–7s: the assassin attacks first. The swordswoman deflects the strike and the two enter a short, fast, fluid exchange with a few clean blade clashes and precise footwork. Snow kicks up under their feet. Keep the choreography compact, elegant, and realistic.

7–10s: the swordswoman gains control, steps inside the final attack, and delivers one decisive finishing cut. The assassin freezes for a brief moment, then naturally drops to his knees and falls backward into the snow. End on the swordswoman breathing hard with her sword lowered as snow continues to fall.

Realistic body motion, grounded combat, elegant pacing, cinematic atmosphere, coherent anatomy, natural fall, no game-like repetitive attack cycles.
